residual_risks: Two pre-existing test failures in the repository (unrelated to T065) remain: tests/test_abi_artifacts.py::test_artifact_byte_matches_regenerated_oracle_output (missing v4-core Solidity source files in tools/oracle/lib) and tests/test_documentation_citations.py::test_check_passes_on_real_repository (doc cites storage.schema and backtest.manifest/backtest.robustness modules that do not resolve). These were present on the base commit before this T065 attempt and were not caused by any change in this attempt; they are outside T065's scope and the layered rules forbid editing the maintenance lane paths the audit report references.

The T065 strategy uses the standard Q64.64 convention (price_q64_64 = price * 2**64) for the price-to-sqrt-price conversion (shift = 128). This is consistent with the canonical V4 reference math but differs from the in-tree baselines module's pre-existing internal convention (which uses shift = 64). The T061 engine forwards events as-is; tests in this task construct events with the standard Q64.64 convention. The discrepancy with the baselines module is a pre-existing implementation choice the baselines module does not document; the T065 module documents its convention explicitly.

The 5-minute return computation depends on the visible events carrying a USDG-converted price_q64_64. In production this requires the T053 qualified USDG quote source to feed the ingest pipeline; that gate is owned by an earlier task and T065 only consumes the projected snapshot.

The RETURN transition is detected from the portfolio snapshot's ``in_range`` flag, which mirrors the engine's recorded ledger state. The T061 backtest engine (src/robinhood_lp/backtest/engine.py) does not yet write ``in_range`` back into PositionState during the fill stage — PositionState.with_updates is invoked for tick_lower / tick_upper / liquidity / last_accrual_time but not for ``in_range``. The strategy's transition detection therefore depends on the adapter-side ledger (adapter.py line 443: ``in_range = bool(ledger.in_range) and not is_empty``) carrying the engine's most recent flip. Production deployment will require the engine to materialise the flip; that wiring is owned by T061/T067 and is outside T065's surface, but it must land before live execution for the RETURN lifecycle action to be reachable through a real engine run. Test-side, TestGoldenOutOfRangeLifecycle::test_return_to_range_after_out_of_range_emits_return constructs the snapshot directly with ``in_range=False`` and so exercises the strategy path today.

Default parameters (5% down-trend threshold, 10% / 25% asymmetric jump thresholds, 60% range occupancy threshold, 5 sample minimum, 25% own-share maximum, 1.0 rebuild-cost ratio threshold) are placeholders bound for the post-testnet paper/shadow evidence gate (T093). They are explicit and reversible; no production default is committed by this attempt.
